comparison.objective: Seat a Mini-ITX board onto four standoffs with its ports aligned; candidate sifts mixed finishing media and workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar multi-pin alignment and fragile-board placement versus bimanual load sharing, tilting/agitation, particle passage, and retention control.
comparison.success_condition: Four holes seated, I/O aligned, board still and hands clear versus recovery ratio, washer retention, support contact, release, and dwell with hard spill/damage failures.
comparison.reason: Multi-point component seating and selective many-body screening have different physical constraints and observable outcomes. Missing rubric details: none material.
